items.title: Nvidia, Apple, Broadcom in 'fierce' battle to make chips at TSMC
items.author: Katie Tarasov
items.highlights: As Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.'s Add To Watchlist record quarter makes clear, demand from chipmakers shows no sign of slowing down. In fact, TSMC can't manufacture quickly enough. The artificial intelligence boom has created unending need for space on factory lines at the world's leading chip manufacturer, and it could put a chokehold on the entire industry's ability to scale. Last year, TSMC said it had the capacity to make more than 17 million 12-inch equivalent wafers. But customers want more. items.author: Senad Karaahmetovic
